question.text: What is the Instant Access Facility (IAF) in the context of mutual fund investor services?

answer.text: A facility to invest in any mutual fund scheme instantly through UPI
A facility offered in Overnight and Liquid schemes that provides same-day credit of redemption proceeds to resident individual investors, subject to prescribed per-day per-investor limits
A feature that allows instant KYC verification for new investors
A service that provides instant NAV calculation before market closure

explanation.text: The Logic: The Instant Access Facility is offered in Overnight and Liquid schemes and allows same-day credit of redemption proceeds for resident individual investors, subject to the prescribed limit per day per investor per scheme. It is meant to give investors quick access to their money from these short-duration cash-management schemes, rather than waiting for the standard T+1 redemption cycle. The Trap: Option A confuses IAF with general UPI-based purchase channels. Options C and D describe unrelated services (KYC and NAV computation). IAF is specifically a redemption-side facility limited to Overnight/Liquid schemes and to resident individual investors. Note: The same-day credit is available only within the prescribed limits; redemption requests above those limits follow the regular processing cycle.
